title: SSRF fix silently breaks contacts with MagicDNS hostnames as mailbox_host
description: is_valid_fetch_host now rejects plain hostnames to prevent SSRF via DNS. However, extract_mailbox_host extracts the host from the remote kithd's apiUrl field in the JMAP session. If a kithd instance includes a MagicDNS hostname in its apiUrl (e.g. https://alice.tail-xxx.ts.net/jmap/api), the stored mailbox_host is a hostname, and is_valid_fetch_host returns false. fetch_peer_blob returns FetchBlobError::HostRejected with only a tracing::warn log. The contact appears valid in Contact/get but blob fetches silently fail. Any manually added contact with a hostname mailbox_host is also broken. The SSRF fix should log a more actionable error or probe_peer should normalise apiUrl hostnames to their tail IP before storing.
